Chapter 20 Diseases and Disorders of the Neurological System  615
Nutritional Implications
Individuals with epilepsy and seizure disorders can be at 
nutritional risk. For infants, children, and adolescents,
impaired ability to consume adequate nutrients, limited 
food choices (if on a ketogenic diet), and drug-nutrient 
interactions may interfere with the ability to achieve op-
timal growth and development.25 Because the ketogenic
diet is low in ﬁ ber and calcium and insuﬃ  cient in other 
nutrients, supplementation is recommended to avoid 
deﬁ ciencies.26 Fluid restriction has been commonly 
used with this treatment in the past, yet most practi-
tioners do not restrict ﬂ uid today, as no seizure control
beneﬁ ts have been shown.27 In fact, due to the diuretic
